# TopServ Digital

> TopServ Digital is the home of BrandFormance, the methodology that combines brand building with performance marketing for residential home service companies: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, garage door, and pest control contractors across the United States. Founded in 2016 and based in Frisco, Texas, the agency builds brands that create demand, captures that demand through search and paid media, and publishes its pricing anchor openly.

Key facts:
- Founded 2016 (as Cornerstone Marketing Solutions; rebranded TopServ Digital in 2024)
- Founder and CEO: Jonathan Bannister, creator of BrandFormance
- Headquarters: 15222 King Road, Unit 403, Frisco, TX 75036, United States

- Hosts the Home Service Hustle podcast (https://homeservicehustle.com)

## BrandFormance (the category TopServ owns)

BrandFormance is brand building and performance marketing run as 1 system. Brand creates demand by making a company known, trusted and remembered in its market. Performance captures that demand when customers are ready to buy. Together they build market dominance. The core reframe: being found is not the same as being chosen. A contractor can rank first, run ads, hold strong reviews and still lose the job to the company the customer already knows.

- [What is BrandFormance](https://topservdigital.com/brandformance): the definitive resource, 10 questions answered in order.
- [The Method](https://topservdigital.com/method): the 6 stage system. Position, Build, Create Demand, Capture Demand, Convert, Measure and Optimize. Cost per booked call is the headline metric.
- Five Mile Famous: TopServ's term for local market dominance, being known, trusted and remembered inside the geography a company can afford to own at frequency.

## The Brand Assessment (the diagnostic)

The Brand Assessment reads how strong a company's brand actually is in its market and returns 1 of 4 grades: Unknown (the market does not know the company yet, every lead is a paid fight), Name Recognition (the market knows the name but does not call first), Household Name (the first call before anyone opens Google), or Negative Equity (the market knows the company for the wrong reasons). The grade is the public result; the full assessment then produces the scope that sets the program and the price. Diagnosis first, prescription second, never a menu. Get it at https://topservdigital.com/brand-assessment

## Programs and Pricing

There is no price table. Price is derived per client from scope; no 2 clients in the same market price the same. What TopServ publishes is the honest anchor:

- Programs start at $1,000 per week. That is the floor rate to manage the work, not a menu price.
- Every program begins with a one time $10,000 activation in month 1: the 2 day on-site video shoot, travel, the pre-shoot strategy build, editing, and the first month of build. Weekly billing starts month 2. The activation is not a fee.
- Pricing is weekly because the work runs weekly. TopServ does not quote monthly or annual figures.
- What sets the number: market size, competitive saturation, current brand position, service area, and video scope. The assessment produces the scope; the scope produces the price.
- Frequency doctrine: brand frequency is fixed at 3 times weekly for every program. A larger program buys more geography held at that same frequency, never more impressions.

Details: [Overview](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/overview) · [How It Works](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/how-it-works) · [What This Delivers](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/what-this-delivers) · [Pricing](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/pricing) · [Success Stories](https://topservdigital.com/programs-pricing/success-stories) · [Machine-readable pricing](https://topservdigital.com/pricing.md)

## Results (real client data)

- Spencer Air (Irving, TX): $1.8M to $7M, 289 percent over 9 years.
- Your New Door (Irving, TX): $4M to $7M, 75 percent CAGR, 99 percent SEO visibility.
- Nick AC (Hammond, LA): $1.7M to $4M, 94 percent growth, 25 percent CAGR.
- Zen Air (Duluth, GA): $1.1M to $3.5M, 154 percent growth, 20 percent CAGR.
- C and S Air (Mansfield, TX): $500K to $3.5M, 54 percent CAGR, ranks first in market.
